rv.q: AN AMERICAN DREAM By LAURIE WINER TIMES THEATER CRITIC "Ragtime" is an intensely moving musical that is rich enough theater to address heart-rending concerns about where we come from and who we would like to be. So great is its duration of all back three hours or so, you are likely to spend fighting tears.
